description: Built a multi-tenant SaaS LMS from the ground up using Next.js and Node.js, supporting multiple institutions on shared infrastructure with tenant-scoped data and admin controls.
Developed a digital advertising platform for TV ad campaign management, covering scheduling, delivery tracking, and reporting for media planning teams.
Designed and built backend systems for a college application management platform, improving applicant workflows and operational efficiency for staff.
Worked directly with clients end-to-end — requirements, architecture, implementation, and deployment — across each engagement.
